newsitem.title: USA: Quigley seeks SEC probe of fake releases.
newsitem.headline: Quigley seeks SEC probe of fake releases.

text.p: Quigley Corp said Friday it had asked the Securities and Exchange Commission to probe repeated attempts to discredit the company through fake press releases and incorrect information posted on the Internet.
Quigley said fake press releases included the resignation of a key executive and an overseas stock offering.
It said the false information ran on major news and financial wires.
It also said several large drug chains that are Quigley customers, and a financial research firm, have received faxes containing inaccurate information trying to discredit the company.

"Someone is deliberately trying to harm the company, its customers and its stockholders," said Guy Quigley, chief executive. "We have asked the SEC to get to the bottom of this to protect the interests of our stockholders."
Quigley is the maker of Cold-Eeze, a zinc gluconate glycine lozenge.
